title: [finding] class closure: the alternate read doors of /meta/:type/:name (/layers, ?layers=true, /published) serve a set-gated doc's BODY to a non-holder; they skip every per-caller read gate the plain read applies
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`: `serveMetaItemLayered` and the `/meta/:type/:name/published` handler. Finding class **(a)**, with `reach:` measured at a public HTTP door; security exception: it leaks data. Filed as the family's **class-closure card**: #20130 is the first member (the app document), and this is the second.

Found by the `os-dev` round on #20129 (PR #20155), and verified at source and filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (measured)

The dev drove the real route handlers on `origin/main` `16c5a33fdd` with a protocol double that implements `getMetaItemLayered`. All reads were healthy. The caller is authenticated and does not hold `crm_admin`. `crm_admin_runbook` is a doc that only a `{ permissionSet: 'crm_admin' }` book claims.

| door | answer |
|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/doc/crm_admin_runbook` (control) | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| `GET /meta/doc/crm_admin_runbook/layers` | **200, the gated body in `code` / `overlay` / `effective`** |
| `GET /meta/doc/crm_admin_runbook?layers=true` (deprecated flag) | **200, the same body** |
| `GET /meta/doc/crm_admin_runbook/published` | **200, the gated body** |

**The seat's reading at source** (`origin/main` `8d1f7ab7`):
- `serveMetaItemLayered` is reached from both layered entry points (the `/layers` route and the `?layers=` branch of the plain read). It applies the ADR-0106 object-schema mask and nothing else. There is no ADR-0046 §6.7 audience arm.
- `isAudienceGatedType` (`metaType === 'book' || metaType === 'doc'`) is read only by the cache exclusion and by the uncached single-item branch's gate. Neither alternate door consults it.

## The class, and the enumeration the closure pin owes

The plain single-item read `GET /meta/:type/:name` applies a per-caller read gate for three types. The alternate doors that serve the same document skip all of them:

| gate on the plain read | type | `/layers` + `?layers=true` | `/published` | `/history`, `/diff` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ADR-0046 §6.7 docs audience | `doc` | **measured: leaks the body** | **measured: leaks the body** | NOT MEASURED |
| ADR-0046 §6.7 docs audience | `book` | NOT MEASURED | NOT MEASURED | NOT MEASURED |
| nav filter (`filterAppForUserWithReason`) | `app` | measured on #20130 | measured on #20130 | code-read on #20130 |
| service gate (`filterDashboardForUser`) | `dashboard` | code-read only: absent from `serveMetaItemLayered` | NOT MEASURED | NOT MEASURED |

⇒ The close is one census pin over **gated type × alternate door**. For each cell, the alternate door answers what the plain read answers for the same caller, or refuses. Every door then runs the gate as a reader of one shared spelling, rather than each door gaining its own copy. #20130 is this family's app row, and triage decides whether it folds in here or stays a member card.

## The contract it contradicts

- ADR-0046 §6.7: docs content is gated server-side at the doc and book reads.
- The by-name route's own rule, quoted on #20130: 「the by-name route must not serve a nav entry the list route prunes, or reading the single-app JSON defeats the filter」. This card is the same lesson for the doc body. The leaked bytes here are the gated content itself, not entry names.

## Reach and context

- **Not the #20129 defect.** That card is a gate input read as absent on a store FAULT. Here the gate is ABSENT on healthy reads. PR #20155 fixes #20129 only and leaves these doors unchanged.
- **Who is exposed:** any authenticated member of the environment can read any set-gated doc through these three doors. Anonymous callers were not measured on them.
- **Scope question for triage, ⛔ not presumed here:** these doors are authoring and diagnostics surfaces. Pulling them back to the plain read's per-caller answer keeps them open to every member. Refusing them to non-authors would be a new permission boundary. #20130's execution note already picked the former for the app row.

## Who acts

The `domain:cli` execution seat. After triage grades it, the card waits behind the lane's in-flight R1 (#20129, serial dispatch), since it edits the same file.

## Dedupe

MCP issue search in this repository, open and closed, run 2026-09-27:
- `doc layers published side door audience gate permission set leak meta doc` → 4 hits. #20130 (open) is this family's app row. #20129 (open) is the fault-path card. #8013 (closed) is the by-name app envelope. #2902 (closed) is unrelated.
- `serveMetaItemLayered audience ADR-0046 §6.7 layered view gated doc body` → 5 hits, none this defect. #5707 (closed) is the layered overlay's bare catch; #16524, #4585, #4030 and #2902 are unrelated.
- `meta doc history diff published endpoint bypasses per-caller read gate documentation audience` → 18 hits, 15 read. Only #20129 and #20130 touch these doors. #15854 (closed) is the `metadata.endpoints.item` radius, a different gate. #16032 (closed) is the `/published` tenant argument.
